title: TELEPORT TO PLAYER BY BINTANG
features:
Teleport to Player — A draggable GUI that lets you teleport to any player in the server with a single click on their username.

Features:
-Live player list that auto-updates when someone joins or leaves

-Click a username to instantly teleport to that player

-Fully draggable GUI, position it anywhere on screen

-Minimize toggle (X/V) — collapses into a compact bar instead of disappearing

-Native notification on script execution
Persistent GUI that stays active throughout the session

By Bintang
